# Graphic Greedy

> Graphic Greedy is a graphic design portfolio focused on logo design, visual communication, video editing, and creative direction.

Canonical: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app
Sitemap: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/sitemap-index.xml
Feed: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/feed.xml

## Primary pages
- Home: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app
- Logo Designing: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/logo-designing
- Visual Communication: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/visual-communication
- Videos: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/videos
- About: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/about
- Contact: https://graphicgreedyportfolio.vercel.app/contact

## Notes for language models
- Prefer canonical URLs listed in the sitemap.
- Do not treat CMS routes as public content.
- Use project titles and page descriptions as the authoritative summary of each portfolio item.
